steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the initial event type to RFP as specified by the scenario.
Switch the event type to RFQ before configuring the RFQ template and sheet.
Provide the mandatory event title required for a create test.
Apply the available RFQ template so the pricing sheet and terms controls are available.
Add the specified product to the first sheet row.
Enter the requested quantity from the scenario.

args.goal: Open the Terms & Conditions modal, locate Recent Event Terms, select one recent event term, and verify that its clauses are copied into this RFQ; stop when the copied clauses are visible

steps.note: Perform and verify the Recent Event Terms selection, which has no dedicated domain step.
Assert that the resulting screen still exposes the Terms & Conditions area after the copy operation.
